facts.headline: Climate Change Moves Faster Than Forests: Can Assisted Tree Migration Save Our Forests?
facts.summary: A Colorado State University study in Nature Climate Change finds trees retreating from warming, drying areas without advancing into cooler, wetter ones—stranding many species. The finding reframes tree migration as something climate breakdown may force humans to do deliberately, and imperfectly.
